native_qa.require: Identical bar OHLC, first loaded bar, context and settings within each pair.

untouched_selector.require: New dedicated immutable snapshot before evaluating. Do not use original sealed November 16–January 11 or consume the Precision forward tape. No proxy holdout from historical windows.

policies.parent: Every original Direct Trend Shadow geometry-admitted diagnostic offer, under its original lifecycle. Observation-only sources remain in the event ledger. Approved S5 and RC2 are unaffected independent controls.

shared.confirmation: Native or replayed source close on a complete confirmed bar; never relabel an early watch or move its time.
shared.frozen_edge: Price strictly beyond a source level known before the decision for breakout or beyond the original broken level for a confirmed retest. Preserve original stop, targets, expiry and rejection.
shared.alignment: Last closed H1 and H4 both in direction of the signal; missing or warmup-unverified snapshots remain UNKNOWN, opposing confirmed observations are CONFLICT. HTF reconstructed from an archive with different warmup is not native parity.
shared.body_rule: Direction-signed body divided by prior confirmed ATR, no recalculation at a later close.
shared.room_rule: Original causal geometry, with a known opposing structural barrier and known modeled costs. Source fallback risk used when no opposing structure is known cannot qualify.
shared.portfolio: No changes to S5 or RC2. Mark occupancy using the matched approved campaign ledger where available. An UNKNOWN slot, costs, structure, or expiry cannot produce RESEARCH PRIORITY.

policies.P1_BREAKOUT: Original STRUCTURAL_BREAK or CONSOLIDATION_BREAK confirmed offers passing shared gates.
policies.P2_RETEST: Original PULLBACK_RETEST confirmed offers passing shared gates. Reuse the original retest entry timestamp and invalidation.
policies.partial_evidence: If full event-time HTF, lifecycle or cost evidence is unavailable, NO DATA for promotion. Report known structural gates in a separate historical ablation, omit only the unavailable gates, never treat an unknown gate as a pass or count its replay as full-selector evidence.
policies.triage_precedence: Source invalidation, expiry or known risk failure; confirmed opposing conflict; complete qualified confirmed research; early or known weak/mixed observation; otherwise NO DATA. Approval is an independent literal source field.

execution.intrabar: Bid/ask open gap first, then stop before TP on ambiguous OHLC. Keep all exclusions and unfilled/blocked plans.
execution.mark_to_market: Quote-side liquidation equity including open risk and modeled exit commission. Same capital/risk basis as pinned comparable control; label any unmatched control separately.

evaluation.false_reclaim: A complete next three closes strictly back through the previously frozen breakout edge. Require all three bars within archive, denominator of eligible breakouts and 95% Wilson interval. This label is offline only.
evaluation.event_definition: Reuse pinned Precision independent historical move events, with their causal detection timestamps and ex-post boundaries kept separate. Describe regimes by closed H1/H4 alignment where exact, or mark UNKNOWN. Score both sides, missed events and latencies.
evaluation.inference: Historical windows descriptive with chronological cuts. No independent significance claim.
